selection: The last untested big lever: FULL training of a CoAtNet, the family our blend is built on, with the recipe that works (model65/model72: all layers from ImageNet-12k/1k weights, GPU augmentation, plain soft-label BCE on the Gemini v1 labels, 16 windows/study, batch 8, cosine, fixed 25 epochs, epoch by weak-val BCE). 256 px to keep one run inside the spend rail; the public Raptor arms we fine-tune are this same backbone. Our one earlier from-ImageNet CoAtNet attempt diverged, but that was BEFORE augmentation existed in the recipe - the same fix that made ResNet34 (0.9104) and EfficientNet-B0 (0.9143) work. Forum reference: Raymond Yuen, full-trained CoAtNet at 288 px, 0.938 LB. The backbone is rebuilt at 256 px (backbone_img_size): all 478 tensors of the 384-px checkpoint load with no shape mismatch, verified locally before relaunching. Attempt 3: gradient checkpointing on and chunk 64 -> 12 after the 24 GB card ran out of memory (73M params, batch 8 x 16 windows = 128 images per step). The recipe itself is unchanged - same batch, windows, epochs and schedule as model65/model72 - so the comparison stays clean; checkpointing costs roughly 30% more time. Attempt 6 (2026-09-26): the first real run reached only gold 0.5836 after 5 epochs with weak-val BCE stuck at ~0.50 and the TRAINING loss flat around 0.5 - underfitting, not overfitting, so the encoder LR of 2e-4 inherited from the small-CNN recipe was destroying the pretrained features. Stopped at 0.44 USD. This attempt lowers encoder_lr to 2e-5, lengthens warmup to 10% and raises chunk to 32 (memory was only 5.4/24 GB). Everything else unchanged.
